Ui_EngineDescription: The Nemotron 3.5 speech model (about 0.74 GB) and a small NVIDIA component. Runs on this PC; nothing else to install.
Ui_AccelerationExpectedGpu: Will try the graphics card (GPU). The one actually used shows after the first transcription.
Ui_LiveTranscriptionDescription: Shows captions on screen while you record. The saved transcript is always made from the recording after you stop; turning this off skips only the live preview.
Ui_LiveNeedsEngine: Download the transcription engine to use this.
Ui_SpeakerLabelsDescription: Labels up to four voices as Speaker 1 to 4. Needs a small extra model (about 0.14 GB) and uses more of the PC while transcribing.
Ui_ErrorYouTubeUrl: That isn't a YouTube video link.
Ui_ErrorYtDlpInstall: Couldn't set up the YouTube downloader. Check your connection and try again.
Ui_RecipeDiscussedPrompt: Give a short recap of what has been discussed so far.
Ui_RecipeActionItemsPrompt: Extract owners and next steps. If the owner is not in the context, say unassigned.
Ui_RecipeFollowUpEmailPrompt: Draft a concise follow-up email. Do not send it.
Ui_RecipeNextStepsPrompt: List my next steps from this meeting.
Ui_RecipeProjectPlanPrompt: Draft a short project plan from this meeting: outcome, steps, owners, open questions. Do not invent owners.
Ui_RecipeKeyIdeasPrompt: List the main ideas of this recording in order. For each one, give its time range and one or two sentences. Use only what is in the recording.
Ui_RecipeExplainPrompt: Find the hardest concepts in this recording and explain each one simply, with a concrete example. Stay faithful to what was said and mark any example of your own.
Ui_RecipeQuotesPrompt: Quote the most notable lines of this recording word for word, each with its timestamp and the speaker when known. Do not paraphrase or invent quotes.
Ui_RecipeStudyPrompt: Write 5 review questions about this recording, each followed by its answer taken from the content.
Ui_RecipeRecurringThemesPrompt: Identify patterns across the packed meetings.
Ui_RecipeWeeklyUpdatePrompt: Write bullets of decisions, blockers, and next steps. Draft only. Do not send it.
Ui_RecipeLiveCatchUpPrompt: Catch me up on the last 2 minutes of the live recording: what was said, who said it when known, and anything I need to act on. Use the recent transcript, answer in a few bullets, and cite times as (mm:ss).
Ui_RecipeLiveSummaryPrompt: Summarize the recording so far: the main topics in order, the decisions and the open questions. Use the session context, the running summary and the recent transcript, and cite times as (mm:ss).
Ui_RecipeLiveQuestionsPrompt: Suggest 3 to 5 good questions I could ask right now, based on what has been discussed and what is still unclear. For each one, say briefly why and give the time it relates to as (mm:ss).
Ui_RecipeLiveDecisionsPrompt: List the decisions made and the tasks agreed so far, with the owner when it was said (otherwise unassigned). Cite times as (mm:ss). If there are none yet, say so.
Ui_ChatApplySummaryBody: This answer will replace the meeting's current summary. If it has action items, they replace the current ones too. You can undo it right after.
Ui_ChatSummaryBusy: A summary is being generated for this meeting. Try again when it finishes.
Ui_ChatSummaryEmpty: This answer has no text to use as a summary.
Ui_LiveQuestionsDescription: Shows a card when someone asks a question in the meeting, so you can answer it with one click. Nothing is answered until you choose Answer.
Ui_LiveQuestionsRulesAi: On, checked by the summary engine
Ui_ChatAttachUnsupported: This type of file cannot be attached. Use PDF, Word, PowerPoint, text, or an image.
